Name: Animated Harvest Crops
Author: WisnuNug
Description:
[size=5][u][b]Animated Harvest Crops[/b][/u]
[/size]
﻿
[url=https://imgur.com/l0jRZR1][img]https://i.imgur.com/l0jRZR1.gif[/img][/url]


[size=4]Added All season crops with simple Animated. With option enable/disable on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM[/url], If you want to change the speed of animation go to [i]content.json[/i] change the "AnimationFrameTime": X, to whatever you want.[/size]


[size=5][u][b]Installation

[/b][/u][/size]Make sure you have installed latest all these mods :
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animation[/url]﻿
[/list]
Put the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, Start up the game. Enjoy..
